The '''tunnel worm''' was a type of four-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long segmented [[Worm/Legends|worm]] that lived on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. They were [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]], could bite, and burrowed tunnels in the earth. Tunnel worms frequently hunted around their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] habitable, Type I&ndash;[[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] craters, where the largest amounts of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] were available, but their ability to store [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] in their body also allowed to them to hunt on Tasariq's surface, where the atmosphere was Type III.<ref name="Journal15" />

The residents of the planet's inhabited craters made concerted efforts to control the number of tunnel worms in their vicinity. At some point by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], an attack by tunnel worms on the [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] [[Ansan Talam]] caused irreparable damage to the vehicle, which forced him to purchase an [[All Terrain Cruiser K-111]] [[steam rover]] instead.<ref name="Journal15" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWAJ15.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Tunnel worms were introduced in ''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 15.]]
The tunnel worm was mentioned in "[[Tasariq: The Crystal Planet]]," a [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' source article written by [[Tom Moldvay]] and [[Steve Miller]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. In two instances, the article capitalizes the creature's name as "Tunnel Worm."<ref name="Journal15" />

"Tasariq: The Crystal Planet" also includes a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure idea in which the player characters travel the distance of 2,300 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] between the planet Tasariq's [[Tasariq City]] and the [[Roaring Crater]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] settlement. The article suggests that, on each [[Local day/Legends|day]] of that journey across Tasariq's surface, the characters have a one-in-eighteen chance of encountering the planet's wildlife, which the gamemaster player can decide (or choose at random) to be either [[spidercat]]s, [[sting-snake]]s, or tunnel worms.<ref name="Journal15" />
